status: Prepared, not run on original geometry; original BLEND and source PNG restoration pending
gate_before_rendering: View actual restored source pixels and sign source-edge errors. Run only relevant one-factor trials, not the whole list automatically.
fixed: All original cameras, lights, water, shoreline and forest. Only primary shell and 19 veins may change through one shared transform.
render_budget: Four 960x540 frames per retained trial, 6 samples, 2 CPU, no denoise. No final suite.
success: Target edge error improves beyond annotation uncertainty; no primary-view or auxiliary regression beyond uncertainty; technical shell and vein tests hold. Low previews only screen trials; confirm chosen local boundary at native pixel resolution.
stop: No supported source edge, improvement depends on one view/camera compensation, cross-view regression, wrong input SHA, missing dependencies, geometry/visibility change outside 20 targets, or topology failure.
unproven: Actual source fit, full mesh collision, normal thickness, water contact, hidden underside, exact metric scale. Analytic reversibility is not proof of those.
